summary: Alert only when public project metadata drifts
description: Add a deterministic read-only watchdog that compares live GitHub repository metadata and audit expiry against data/public-projects.json, stays silent when current, and emits one compact Dutch alert with exact old/new evidence when review is needed. No automatic site edits or deployment.
acceptance: Green live metadata and non-urgent audit expiry produce empty stdout and exit 0.
New/missing repositories, archive/fork changes, pushed/head/description/homepage/release drift, and near/expired audit produce one bounded Dutch alert without leaking credentials.
Synthetic drift tests prove exact repo, field, previous value, current value and proposed action are reported; no site files or GitHub state are mutated.
